caseName: U. S. Ex Rel. Handler v. Hill, Warden
caseNameFull: United States of America, Ex Rel. Nathan Handler v. Henry C. Hill, Warden, Etc.
attorneys: Mr. Lewis Landes for petitioner. No appearance for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit denied for the reason that the application for writ of certiorari was not made within the time provided by law. Section 8 (a), Act of February 13, 1925, 43 Stat. 936, 940.
